newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's banking liquidity rises 35.2 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's banking liquidity rises 35.2 pct in '96.

text.p: Liquidity in Ecuador's banking system rose 35.2 percent last year to 17 billion sucres ($4.64 billion), the central bank said Monday.
The banking liquidity measure advanced 9.7 percentage points more than consumer prices, which rose 25.5 percent in 1996.
In 1995, bank liquidity rose to 12.6 billion sucres ($3.43 billion), marking a 41.8 percent rise from a year earlier.
Separately, the central bank said Ecuador's monetary base rose 26.9 percent in 1996 to 3.1 billion sucres ($836 million). At the end of 1995, the monetary base stood at 2.4 billion sucres.
